decision: Original SSH-interrupted phase was closed; retain completed LasHeR, run two independent remaining datasets concurrently, two inference workers per card. No third worker per card.

evidence.scope: Four complete DEV videos per phase, same checkpoint and work; serial/parallel/parallel/serial order. End-to-end timing includes process/model startup and decoding. Short throughput study, not accuracy result.

interpretation: Memory and CPU headroom are measured separately from throughput. The equal-work test supports two workers per card. Three workers and training concurrency have not been measured.
